cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Apologize for the Lie
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that the concealment or misdirection mattered, even if the underlying choice was defensible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll sort this out. You showed me the rescue dog's photo, not the page saying he eats sofas.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He can stay. But tell me you knew that missing page would change my answer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's choose one he can't eat. First, say I should have seen that page.

reason: A accommodates keeping the dog and shared replacement shopping while preserving the requirement to acknowledge withheld information; B4 offer directly creates A5 practical next step.
